_comment: Hand classification of living plants, by looking at their sprites. A name ending in * matches every name with that start. Shapes: palm (trunk under drooping fronds), crown (a domed canopy on a trunk), poplar (a tall narrow crown), bush (a low dome with no trunk), fern (low fronds), decal (flat on the ground). Built things: flat (a flat roof with a parapet), vault (a barrel roof), granary (a round silo with a cone roof), well (a low stone ring), site (a lodestone site's round plinth with the site art on top).
